messages:
jen: heads-up: deploybot paused canary for rollout-2026-04-12 due to p95 spike. decision needed: auto rollback or manual staged unwind?

deploybot: rollout paused (canary). telemetry snapshot: p95=2300ms (SLO 1200ms), error_rate +1.6%, request drop 8%. recommended actions: staged unwind to previous canary variant or full canary revert to v2.13.8.

sam: can we pin dedicated pools first so enterprise tenants stay unaffected?

maria: yes pin dedicated. for public hosted traffic prefer targeted canary rollback only.

ops_lead: change window open until 05:00 UTC. avoid full revert if we can contain it.

eng_oncall: propose: manual rollback for the canary slice, monitor p50/p95/errors for 10m. pass criteria: p95 < 1.3s AND error_delta < 0.5%.

ryan: I'll execute if we agree. planned command:
```
redwood deploy rollback --target rollout-2026-04-12 --scope canary --to v2.13.8
```

sam: after rollback we need a release-note blurb + customer note for dedicated accounts. I can draft.

maria: draft blurb: "Canary rollout for 2026-04-12 temporarily rolled back due to latency regression; dedicated pools pinned and unaffected. Investigation ongoing."

ops_lead: roles: sam -> release notes, jen -> customer alert (dedicated), ryan -> execute, eng_oncall -> monitor & report.

jen: @deploybot ready to run staged unwind once ryan confirms.

deploybot: ack. awaiting operator confirmation. runbook reference attached.

ryan: executing now. START rollback 3456007922.

eng_oncall: observing metrics. initial post-rollback p95 = 1.15s, error rate at baseline. continuing 10m watch.

sam: draft release note: "We temporarily rolled back the canary portion of the 2026-04-12 rollout after a latency regression in early canary telemetry. Only canary traffic was affected; dedicated/reserved pools were pinned and experienced no disruption. RCA in progress."

maria: add customer contact: "Dedicated customers who observed increased latency should contact support@redwood.ai."

ryan: FINISH rollback 3456007933. canary now at v2.13.8. logs: internal deploy logs linked.

eng_oncall: 10m watch complete — metrics stable. moving to postmortem triage.

jen: follow-ups: eng to open RCA ticket; sam to publish release note + customer alert within 30m.

sam: will send notes and update changelog.

maria: closing thread after comms sent. :thumbsup:
